x: Mark Humphries had his first outing in the steeplechase and considering the difficulty he had negotiating the barriers his time of 11:29.4 for third place was very respectable.

In the combined A and B 1500m race Jamie and Mark Humphries, making his league debut, decided to race each other and Mark's finishing burst in the final straight almost did it, just one-fifth behind but with second B race position to his credit.
